prefs.trackpad_zoom_modifier.help: Hold only this key to zoom at the pointer with vertical scroll. Off keeps the existing scroll behavior.
prefs.value_boxes_in_view: Show values beside their handles in the view
prefs.value_boxes_in_view_tip: A command's value (Distance, Radius…) in a box next to its handle, over the model. Off: you type it in the command window, which takes the keyboard after a pick, and nothing covers the model.
prefs.view_confirm_corner: OK and Cancel in the view's corner
prefs.view_confirm_corner_note: While a dialog or a sketch is open, a check and a cross at the top right of the view do what the dialog's OK and Cancel do, or finish and cancel the sketch. The view navigator moves down below them.
prefs.viewport_analysis_status_help: Show active analyses above the viewport, open their legends from each item, and use Esc to turn off the newest analysis. Turn off to restore corner legends and the previous Esc behaviour.
prefs.viewport_section_status_help: Show the section setting in the viewport. Escape and the active ribbon button turn it off. Disable to keep the previous section controls.
prefs.viewport_status_details_help: Edit active analysis and section settings in standard details cards. Disable to restore read-only analysis keys and the Section dialog.
prefs.viewport_status_summary_help: Fold three or more viewport status items into one summary badge. Disable to keep every item in the full row.
prefs.zoom_stop_at_model_tip: The 3D mouse and device app zoom toward the surface in the middle of the view; drag-zoom holds the point where the drag began. Off: zoom can pass through the model. Wheel and pinch use Zoom to the cursor separately
properties.title: Properties: {name}
render.adaptive_help: GPU only. Independent pilot samples are discarded, then allocate 16 or more production samples per pixel up to Samples per pixel. RGB and coverage variance guide allocation; rare paths may be missed and capped pixels may remain noisy. The final report counts actual work. No certified noise or time guarantee.
render.adaptive_pending: GPU independent-pilot adaptive allocation and conditional Fresnel strata are available. Certified convergence, rare-event guarantees and CPU adaptive transport remain unavailable.
render.advanced_material_scope: One finite homogeneous GPU medium is available under explicit limits. Density grids, nested glass/volume combinations, subsurface surfaces, displacement, spectral transport and unbound advanced material concepts remain unavailable.
render.aging_airborne_help: Airborne dust is a separate finite homogeneous scattering volume. It changes transport and raw EXR, not the surface-aging stack. Existing volume/glass/denoising restrictions remain explicit; no atmosphere is added automatically.
render.aging_empty: No aging layers: the original surfaces remain unchanged.
render.aging_help: Combine up to eight optical layers, in order. Rust and patina are authored appearances, not age/corrosion simulations. Scale is in world millimeters. No geometry, mass or engineering property is changed; glass and passive stages are excluded.
render.aging_target_help: A named target must still match its captured index and name. Global masks are world-anchored; they do not follow moving parts. This is neither cavity detection nor true edge wear. Filter the list to reach additional bodies.
render.all_controls_help: Dense inspection of all current controls. Section pages provide focused editing without changing the underlying request.
render.appearance_editor.body_reason: Optical bindings target one whole body. Pick Body to edit these controls.
render.appearance_editor.glass_enable: Use physical glass on this body
render.appearance_editor.glass_note: Closed glass uses geometric distance. It cannot share a body with clear coat or maps.
render.appearance_editor.remove_note: Remove the saved optics from this shot. Geometry and assigned looks are kept.
render.appearance_editor.save_reason: Saving these optics needs physical glass on a current GPU body. Coat and local image maps remain temporary.
render.appearance_editor.saved_state: These optics are saved with this shot.
render.appearance_editor.scatter_reason: Interior scattering needs a closed solid boundary.
render.appearance_editor.temporary: These optics are temporary on this tab. Save them to keep them with the shot.
render.appearance_editor.thickness_reaso: Thickness applies to thin sheets; closed glass uses geometric distance.
render.appearance_physics_separate: Visual appearance does not assign density, thermal data or other engineering properties.
render.assign_help: Click to apply to the selection; drag to preview and drop, or click with nothing selected to paint.
render.availability_projection: Supported projection; see scope and omissions
render.availability_reference: Reference data; not an automatic assignment
render.backdrop_alpha_conflict: Choose this backdrop or transparent PNG output; the renderer will not silently ignore either setting.
render.backdrop_help: This screen-space backdrop does not illuminate, cast shadows, reflect or represent terrain. It is excluded from raw EXR. Geometry, lights and the HDR environment stay independent.
render.background_completed_frozen: The displayed result is a frozen completed image. Editing a background does not repaint that result automatically. Use Regrade for camera-only changes, or Render for a new physical stage.
render.background_hdr_separate: The current HDR resources illuminate and reflect on surfaces; they are not automatically displayed as a panorama behind the subject. Changing a gradient does not rotate or recolour the lighting.
render.background_lighting_section: HDR illumination · separate from camera background
render.background_no_alpha_override: A camera background is not added to transparent output silently. Raw-master regrading uses captured coverage and does not reapply denoising; the source EXR remains unchanged.
render.background_not_light: Background color is presentation, not an additional lighting source.
render.background_stage_occlusion: This shot includes physical stage geometry. A large floor or wall can fill the frame and hide a camera-only background. Clear or resize the stage deliberately, or change its physical reflectance. Regrading cannot remove captured geometry.
render.background_workflow: Choose the background you intend: a camera-only color/gradient, a physical stage that receives light, or HDR illumination. They are independent. Live Preview is a modeling view; render a new image or regrade a retained master to see camera finishing.
render.base_apply_help: One undoable visual assignment to the reviewed exact body. Existing face-specific looks and engineering materials remain separate.
render.base_opaque_only: This editor preserves opaque body semantics. Use the explicit glass controls for optical transmission.
render.bloom_help: Creative output-only glow from positive linear highlights, spread with three normalized box passes. Radius is in output pixels. Added in linear display light before sRGB; not a lens, volumetric effect or convergence improvement. The raw EXR is unchanged.
render.bloom_opaque: Bloom requires opaque output. Transparent PNG is refused, not silently flattened.
render.camera_exact_help: World millimeters; angles are displayed in degrees and saved as radians. Navigation uses the same camera as the viewport.
render.check_opaque: Transparency: opaque surfaces only; background alpha is supported.
render.children.add_look_reason: Add a look to edit its enabled state and strength.
render.children.denoise: Reduce noise in the finished image
render.children.effects_banner: These effects need GPU path tracing. Opening this never changes the method.
render.children.enable_adaptive: Enable independent pilots to edit the adaptive limits.
render.children.enable_bloom: Enable bloom to edit its strength, threshold and radius.
render.children.needs_cpu: Needs CPU ray tracing. Opening this never changes the method.
render.children.progressive_reason: Choose Progressive to edit its sample count and seed.
render.choose_look: Choose a look in Appearances first
render.cpu_aa_help: Spatial samples: more samples improve edges and increase render time.
render.cpu_area_editor_help: Full side vectors in millimeters; U cross V points toward the emitting side. This differs from GPU half-edge vectors.
render.cpu_binding_stale: The scene changed. Confirm this reflection target again before rendering.
render.cpu_body_filter_more: Refine the filter to see more bodies.
render.cpu_body_missing: A reflection target is missing, hidden, ambiguous or has a name longer than 128 bytes. Choose it again.
render.cpu_budget_help: Choose larger limits explicitly. Resolution and samples are never reduced automatically.
render.cpu_budget_not_guarantee: These are admission ceilings, not a RAM reservation or a speed guarantee. Geometry, film and retained previews share the memory budget; rendering remains cancellable.
render.cpu_budget_resize: The draft exceeds this CPU profile or its camera-sample budget. Accept smaller dimensions explicitly or select a larger profile.
render.cpu_check_capture_help: Check and Start verify the same file digest or use the embedded HDR. Each image keeps its captured source.
render.cpu_check_changed: The controls or model changed after this check. Check again before rendering.
render.cpu_constant_help: Constant radiance is visible to reflected or transmitted rays. It does not provide direct diffuse lighting.
render.cpu_custom_directions: Replace preset with custom directional lights
render.cpu_environment_background: The image background stays separate from environment lighting.
render.cpu_environment_bounds: CPU intensity must be 0–64, HDR rotation finite within ±1,000,000 radians, and HDR samples 1, 4, 16 or 64.
render.cpu_exposure_help: CPU exposure must be between −16 and 16 EV. A GPU exposure outside that range is retained until you change it.
render.cpu_hdr_help: Radiance .hdr, 2:1 panorama, up to 2048 × 1024 and 16 MiB. CPU requires explicit sRGB/D65 primaries in the file; unspecified primaries and EXR are refused.
render.cpu_hdr_reflection_help: HDR rough reflections require fully metallic body and face surfaces. Check reports unsupported combinations.
render.cpu_light_help: Up to eight directional lights. An empty custom list turns them off; selecting a preset restores its lights. Colors are linear RGB and intensity is relative, not watts.
render.cpu_opaque_required: CPU ray tracing needs an opaque background. Clear Transparent background to continue.
render.cpu_options_pending: This CPU panel cannot edit emission, surface effects, glass or anisotropy yet. Clear those API options before using it.
render.cpu_point_help: Up to eight point lights, added to the selected directional lighting. Distances are in mm; the minimum must not exceed the reference distance.
render.cpu_progressive_help: Accumulate the existing CPU integrator in passes of one primary sample. Selected reflections require one sample; area lights, dielectrics and anisotropy require Single image.
render.cpu_progressive_limits: At most 1,048,576 pixels and 16,777,216 pixel × sample evaluations. Changing samples never resizes the image automatically.
render.cpu_reflection_empty: No bodies selected: scene reflections are off.
render.cpu_reflection_help: Choose bodies and set Off, Mirror or Rough. Rough uses the assigned surface roughness. More samples and bounces increase time; this is bounded specular transport, not global illumination.
render.cpu_reflection_limit: Up to 64 reflected bodies are supported.
render.cpu_runtime_help: Numeric light and environment settings are saved with the setup. Body reflections and HDR files remain temporary. Existing area-light and spot-cone values are retained.
render.cpu_summary: CPU ray tracing · reflections · HDR · directional and point lights
render.draft_confirm_help: The current render draft has unapplied edits. Save them before switching, discard them explicitly, or keep editing.
render.effects_gpu_only: These effects require GPU path tracing. Changing the page never switches the renderer automatically.
render.effects_help: Combine ordered color looks and image-space lens effects. Rendering and raw-master regrading use the same saved settings. Raw EXR stays unchanged. These are original artistic controls, not calibrated lens or branded-film emulations.
render.env_backdrop_pending: Environment visibility and background blur are not supported by the renderer yet.
render.env_choose_source: Choose an environment in Studios and Environments before editing the lighting.
render.env_ground_pending: Physical ground receives shadows as a finite diffuse surface. Shadow-only catching and ground reflections are not supported yet.
render.env_preview_help: Illustrative sphere sample; not a preview of the selected environment.
render.env_ring_help: Drag the ring to rotate the lighting. Hold Shift to snap to 15°.
render.env_stage_details: Ground edits require raytracing and a single ground panel. Use Scene to edit other stage panels.
render.environment.backdrop_note: A backdrop is seen by the camera only. It never lights, casts shadows or reflects, and is refused with transparent output.
render.environment.blur_pending: Blur is unavailable: the renderer has no backdrop blur setting.
render.environment.checked: HDR file checked. Saving embeds these bytes.
render.environment.gradient_gpu: Gradient backdrop needs GPU path tracing.
render.environment.primaries: Treat unspecified primaries as linear sRGB
render.environment.primaries_gpu: Interpreting unspecified primaries needs GPU path tracing.
render.environment.radial_only: Center and radius apply to Radial mode.
render.environment.remove_note: Removes the {count} passive panels from this shot. The camera backdrop stays.
render.environment.rotation_hdr: Rotation needs an HDR source for CPU ray tracing.
render.environment.samples_cpu: Lighting samples are set by the GPU path tracing budget; this setting needs CPU ray tracing.
render.environment.sky_note: Original sky gradient for lighting; not a calibrated atmosphere.
render.environment.source_raytrace: Environment sources need CPU or GPU ray tracing.
render.environment.stage_raytrace: Physical stages need CPU or GPU ray tracing.
render.environment.world_pending: World backdrop is unavailable: camera visibility of the environment has no saved setting yet.
render.environment_tiles_require_raytrac: Environments require CPU or GPU ray tracing. Select it in the Output editor.
render.error_body_bound: product preview exceeds its captured-body bound
render.error_checkpoint_dimensions: checkpoint dimensions differ from the captured request
render.error_display_fit: image display cannot fit this device
render.error_export_document: The render export document changed while choosing its destination
render.error_face_cap: product preview exceeds the face-appearance admission cap
render.error_finish_gesture: finish the modeling gesture before previewing
render.error_finish_operation: finish the current modeling operation before entering Render
render.error_fixed_preview: fixed studio preview requires exposure 0, environment rotation 0 and intensity 1
render.error_gpu_preview: GPU product preview is unavailable on this host. Saved setups remain available.
render.error_image_dimensions: render image dimensions do not match its job
render.error_image_profile: render image exceeds its captured resource profile
render.error_physical_glass: the selected recipe is not physical glass
render.error_preview_device: product preview requires an installed device with a depth buffer
render.error_provisional_identity: invalid provisional render identity or sample count
render.error_quality_method: quality projection requires the same explicit GPU method
render.error_scene_body_limit: render scene exceeds its body limit
render.error_setup_stopped: setup worker stopped without returning a host
render.error_source_preview: source preview exceeds its byte envelope
render.error_triangle_bound: product preview exceeds its eight-million-triangle source bound
render.error_vertex_envelope: product preview exceeds its {limit} MiB vertex payload envelope; geometry was not simplified
render.error_vertex_packing: product preview packing differs from its admitted vertex payload
render.error_visible_solid: Create a visible solid in Design to preview it here.
render.exr_pending: GPU can retain raw linear EXR. Compression, multilayer images and auxiliary render passes remain unavailable.
render.gpu_options_help: Samples, depth, seed and exposure are saved with this setup. Only the active image method is saved.
render.gpu_path_first_setup: The first setup on this GPU can take several minutes; SolidCraft stays usable meanwhile. Later starts reuse the compiled shaders where the driver keeps them.
render.gpu_unavailable: GPU path tracing is not ready on this device.
render.hdr_embedded_help: Rendering uses the bytes included in the design; the original file is no longer needed.
render.hdr_file_captured: HDR file checked. Save will embed these bytes; if the file changes, check it again explicitly.
render.hdr_inspect_required: Select and check an HDR file before saving or rendering.
render.hdr_primaries_declared: The source declares its color primaries.
render.hdr_primaries_undeclared: The source does not declare primaries; review the renderer color requirements.
render.hdr_resource_missing: This design is missing the saved HDR resource.
render.image_help: CPU preview image · PNG · approximate transparency
render.image_reduce: Try a smaller image or simpler scene.
render.image_scene_stale: Finish the modeling gesture or refresh the scene before checking or starting an image.
render.image_stale: This image uses the scene captured before subsequent changes.
render.image_supported: Render request is supported; the queue and memory pool are checked again at start.
render.image_too_large: Over the image limit: 4096 pixels per side and 4,194,304 pixels in all.
render.image_use_largest: Use the largest size at this aspect:
render.inspector_opaque_help: Finish and optical fields use opaque PBR (opacity 1). Lower opacity uses scalar shading.
render.inspector_pick_target: Pick a target of this type to inspect its appearance.
render.inspector_set_all: Mixed appearances. Editing sets the look on all selected targets.
render.inspector_target_limit: Select at most 10000 targets to inspect appearances.
render.lens_effects_help: Flare uses up to four separated bright sources in the actual linear image. Ghosts, halo, streaks, chromatic offsets and radial distortion are artistic image-space approximations. Spatial effects need opaque output; outside samples extend the image edge. Grain is deterministic. No physics, EXR or geometry is altered.
render.library_applied: Resource projection applied. Check the complete render request before starting.
render.library_apply_hint: Click to apply · drag onto the model
render.library_authored_help: Original authored resources are illustrative, not measured engineering data. Each action applies only its stated projection.
render.library_emitters_only_ack: Use emitters only; omit the documented passive cards
render.library_empty: No matching resources. Try a different query or availability filter.
render.library_hdr_help: Embeds the original HDR in the saved setup. The authored longitude origin is converted explicitly; no external file is needed after saving.
render.library_inspect_only: Select to inspect; nothing is applied automatically. Favorites and recent history belong to this open document session.
render.library_maps_help: Built-in maps can be saved with pinned sources and local occurrence mapping. Temporary optical overrides remain a separate mode.
render.library_replace_studio: Replace saved lighting, environment and stage
render.library_rig_help: Fit once at an explicit center and physical extent. Complete rigs include passive cards; calibration blockers still refuse. Conservative emitter/card clearance is checked before saving.
render.library_select_hint: Choose a resource in the Library to inspect its supported actions and limitations.
render.library_source_preview_help: Authored base-color source map. This is not a rendered or measured material preview.
render.library_specification_only: Specification only: not a complete executable preset. Required effects, resources and subject roles still need explicit implementation and binding.
render.library_uniform_ack: Use the uniform approximation without spatial or advanced effects
render.light_anchor_pending: Changing the light coordinate frame is not supported yet.
render.light_backend_limit: Choose CPU ray tracing or an explicit GPU studio to edit lights. Legacy GPU studio lights remain read-only.
render.light_gpu_punctual: Point and Spot lights are available with CPU ray tracing.
render.light_hard_shadow: This light has hard shadows; emitter softness is unavailable.
render.light_missing: This light no longer exists. Select a light in the Browser.
render.light_place_pending: Highlight placement needs viewport light picking and is not supported yet.
render.light_preview_help: Live view is unshadowed; Area lights use a center-sample approximation. Render uses the complete light model.
render.light_temperature_help: Approximate blackbody tint; saved as linear RGB.
render.light_view_only: Solo and mute affect this view and its renders; they are never saved in the design.
render.lighting_budget_help: Counts are read-only. Add, duplicate or delete lights to change them; the method sets the limits.
render.lighting_consent: Replace the directional lights with this preset
render.lighting_custom_help: Choosing Custom turns the preset into editable lights, one row each in the tree.
render.lighting_direction_help: Or type a direction toward the light (X Y Z).
render.lighting_falloff_help: Intensity is quoted at the reference distance.
render.lighting_preset_cpu: Directional studio presets require CPU ray tracing. GPU lighting uses explicit Sun and Area lights.
render.lighting_review_help: Replaces the directional light list. Keeps point and area lights, environment, shadows, camera and all other shot settings.
render.lighting_samples_cpu: Area-light samples apply to CPU ray tracing.
render.lighting_samples_need_area: Add a CPU area light to set area samples.
render.lighting_shadow_cpu: The shadow switch requires CPU ray tracing. GPU path tracing always casts shadows.
render.lighting_spot_preserved: This point light retains its saved spot cone until its type is changed.
render.lighting_sun_distance: Sun direction is independent of distance and aim point.
render.linear_help: Keeps a 32-bit float RGBA master before denoising, exposure, tone mapping, filters and backdrop. Linear sRGB/D65; coverage-premultiplied. Additional memory is admitted explicitly. No compression or extra passes.
render.linear_unavailable: The selected completed frame has no retained EXR. Enable retention before rendering; an older PNG cannot recover raw radiance.
render.material_certification: Closed glass uses geometric distance. Topology, orientation, overlap and optical boundaries are checked during GPU preparation; Check only admits the request.
render.material_coat: Clear coat over the base material
render.material_coat_help: Illustrative dielectric coating over the existing opaque appearance. Zero weight leaves the base unchanged.
render.material_filter_help: Up to 128 matching bodies are shown. Refine the filter for large scenes.
render.material_glass_enable: Use physical glass on this body
render.material_glass_exclusive: Glass cannot share a body with clear coat or runtime maps in this renderer.
render.material_glass_help: Original illustrative recipes. Swatches show transmittance, not a rendered preview. Absorption is −ln(linear transmittance) / reference distance; alpha is unchanged.
render.material_gpu_required: These active material overrides require GPU path tracing. Select GPU or disable the overrides before Check or Start.
render.material_limits: At most 128 body overrides, 32 disjoint glass bodies, 64 coats and 128 texture bindings. Identical maps share storage; actual device and total memory limits still apply.
render.material_map_invalid: Map paths must be bounded local paths; normal strength must be finite and between 0 and 1.
render.material_map_required: Choose a color image or a normal image before using maps.
render.material_maps_enable: Enable maps for this opaque body
render.material_maps_help: PNG/JPEG up to 1024×1024; 16 MiB encoded total. U and V are orthogonal world-mm repeat vectors (maximum 128 repeats). Color is sRGB; normal data uses OpenGL +Y. Files are captured at Check/Start.
render.material_refresh_needed: Scene changed. Refresh the body list before adding a target.
render.material_repeat_u: One U repeat X · Y · Z (mm)
render.material_repeat_v: One V repeat X · Y · Z (mm)
render.material_revalidate_needed: This assignment belongs to an earlier scene revision. Revalidate its exact body identity before rendering.
render.material_target_missing: The body ordinal and name no longer match. Remove this assignment and explicitly choose the intended body again.
render.material_transient: Temporary optical overrides for this document tab. They are not saved in the design, render setup or material library.
render.material_v_up: Texture V points upward in the image
render.method_limit_raster: Raster uses the fixed opaque studio preview. Select an explicit raytracing method for supported optical controls.
render.navigation_help: The camera moves as in Design (Preferences › Navigation). Save Setup records the current camera.
render.nested_help: Up to 16 containing layers; every parent must be convex and every child strictly inside it. Intersections, touching surfaces, thin sheets and straight-shadow transmission refuse. Camera-inside state follows the certified hierarchy. Does not create a liquid surface or merge touching CAD boundaries.
render.opaque_image_summary: Preview PNG · opaque PBR · blended transparency
render.opaque_preview_help: Opaque PBR and simple colors; blended transparency. Refraction, HDRI and final rendering are not available yet.
render.optics_replace: Replace this target’s saved optics explicitly
render.optics_save: Save these optics to the setup
render.optics_saved_help: Exact definition, feature and occurrence identity survives offline reopen. Missing/replaced/hidden targets refuse; engineering materials are unchanged. Save or discard numeric edits before removing a saved target.
render.output_check_help: Run Check to review this request without starting a render.
render.output_destination_help: Choose the destination file when exporting the completed image.
render.output_exr_unavailable: EXR output setup is unavailable here. Linear EXR export requires a completed GPU image with a retained linear master.
render.output_format_status: PNG is the exact completed display image. Optional GPU EXR retains raw scene-linear FLOAT32 radiance before display filters. Export never substitutes the preview cache or a different job.
render.output_over_budget: The requested image exceeds the selected resource envelope. Choose a compatible size or profile explicitly; no automatic downgrade occurs.
render.output_presets_help: Format, quality and the Check list are in the Output editor.
render.output_ratio_refused: The linked dimension exceeds this method’s size limit. The previous size is retained; unlock the ratio or choose a smaller value.
render.output_size_limit: {method}: up to {dimension} px per side and {pixels} pixels. Largest fitting size: {width} × {height}.
render.output_size_method_profile: To render {width} × {height}, choose {method} with the {profile} CPU resource profile, or a smaller size.
render.output_size_profile: To render {width} × {height}, choose the {profile} CPU resource profile, or a smaller size.
render.output_tools_inspector: Edit size and format in the Output inspector.
render.passive_stage_help: Finite passive panels belong only to rendered images. They do not add CAD bodies or mass. Placement is fixed after applying; intersecting product bounds refuse. CPU does not provide diffuse bounce lighting.
render.physical_acknowledge: I understand this partial reference needs grade, condition and source review
render.physical_background_help: Real passive floor and wall, separate from the camera backdrop. Cyclorama uses 24 polygonal strips; it is not an infinite or analytically smooth surface. Replaces the saved stage only with your consent.
render.physical_copy_plan: Copy plan with sources and omissions
render.physical_omissions: Properties not representable in the native card
render.physical_plan_only: Read-only plan prepared. No material was created or assigned. Keep its extended profile and omissions when reviewing the native card.
render.physical_separate: Appearance is not material identification. These are sourced references, not certified effective properties. Existing mass, engineering materials and optics are unchanged.
render.physical_unknown: No numerical candidate is established. Grade, formulation or construction must be specified; unknown is not zero.
render.pick_help: Choose Body, Face or Component. Click empty space to clear; Shift or Ctrl adds or toggles. Highlights appear only in the live product view.
render.pick_up_prompt: Click an object to pick up its look
render.pick_waiting: Product picking is not supported yet.
render.post_help: Creative presentation only. RGB gains precede tone mapping; contrast, saturation and vignette follow in display-linear light. Start Render creates new transport samples. Regrade uses the selected retained raw master without denoising or new rays.
render.preview_help: Raster shading and blended transparency. Refraction, HDRI and final rendering are not available yet.
render.preview_image_settings_help: Live Preview keeps fixed studio lighting. Exposure and image lighting apply to the image job when you Check or Start.
render.preview_lighting_help: The live preview shows direct light only and no shadows.
render.preview_unavailable_help: The live preview is unavailable. Saved setups and image-job controls remain accessible. Change the scene or explicitly retry; a refused scene is not rebuilt on every frame.
render.preview_upload_help: Exact preview vertex bytes, not total GPU or process memory. Geometry is not simplified. Image jobs use their own admission and lighting.
render.progressive_image_summary: Preview PNG · PBR and glass · progressive samples
render.quality_ack: Acknowledge the fixed-budget projection and omissions
render.quality_projection_help: Q presets include future requirements. This action projects only a supported fixed-sample PNG budget and explicitly omits adaptive stopping, raw linear output and independent transmission limits.
render.queue_pending: There is no automatic production queue or animation renderer in this UI. Completed still images remain separately exportable.
render.regrade_help: Creates a separate PNG from the selected completed raw master, using these presentation controls. Does not trace rays, change the captured size/camera/lights, or overwrite the EXR. Denoising is not reapplied: raw masters do not retain its guides. The derivative remains exportable through the same job controls.
render.replace_saved_surface: Replace an existing saved binding for this target
render.result_actual_help: One image pixel per display pixel.
render.result_current: The captured model revision is current.
render.result_empty: No completed image yet. Check the settings, then start a render.
render.result_navigation: Pan and zoom use Navigation preferences. Space + drag pans.
render.result_open: Open the completed image in the main canvas.
render.result_provisional_help: This checkpoint is not exportable. Export keeps the last completed result; cancellation returns to that result.
render.result_reduced_display: Display preview reduced to the viewport device/cache limit. The retained PNG and export keep full resolution; native 100% inspection is unavailable for this reduced view.
render.result_retained: Showing the last completed image; a newer render has not replaced it.
render.review_stale: This review is stale. Resolve or check again before applying.
render.ribbon_check_help: Validate the exact current draft that Render will submit. No renderer fallback, silent resize or resource replacement.
render.ribbon_environment_help: HDR illumination, camera-only backgrounds and physical stage surfaces are separate controls with explicit replacement consent.
render.ribbon_finish_dialog: Finish the current file or confirmation dialog first.
render.ribbon_job_active: A render is already running; cancel it explicitly before starting another.
render.ribbon_lights_help: Inspect authored rigs or edit supported lights without replacing the current setup until you explicitly apply the change.
render.ribbon_materials_help: Open the shared appearance inspector and original surface library. Optical edits never silently change engineering properties.
render.ribbon_no_active_job: There is no active render to cancel.
render.ribbon_no_result: Complete a render before exporting its exact image.
render.ribbon_no_saved_camera: Save a shot before restoring its camera.
render.ribbon_studios_help: Browse implemented studio compositions and review their replacements before applying. Concept-only scenes remain labeled.
render.saved_maps_runtime_conflict: Saved surface bindings cannot be mixed with temporary optical overrides or an unsaved HDR. Save the HDR or remove the temporary inputs explicitly.
render.saved_surfaces_help: Pinned built-in maps follow the selected occurrence in local millimeters. A replaced or missing target is an error, never an automatic reassignment.
render.scene_batch_reason: All shots needs the saved-shot render queue, which is not available yet.
render.scene_check_stale: Check out of date · check again
render.scene_consent: Confirm lighting, environment, exposure and stage replacement
render.scene_preserved_fields: Camera, sampling, dimensions, optical bindings, CAD geometry and engineering materials are preserved.
render.scene_preserves_design: Compose lighting and a passive stage for the visible subject. Geometry, engineering materials and the camera remain separate.
render.scene_reminder: Scene preserves the design. Geometry, engineering properties and CAD are never changed from Render.
render.scene_review_help: Review the complete native composition before applying. Unbound advanced SCENE specifications are not substituted.

ui.ai_no_keychain: The system keychain isn't available, so a key can't be stored. A local server without a key still works.
ui.ai_reasoning_effort_hint: Optional. Sent to the endpoint as `reasoning_effort`; accepted values differ per provider (for example `low`, `high` or `max`). A value you set here is never replaced by SolidCraft. Leave empty to send nothing and keep the provider's default.
ui.ai_request_timed_out: The model took longer than {seconds} s. You can raise the request timeout for this endpoint in Preferences › Assistant.
ui.ai_request_timeout_hint: How long one model request to this endpoint may take, from 30 s to an hour. Raise it for a slow local model.
ui.ai_show_features_note: The agent chat: a panel where a coding agent you already use, or a model endpoint you choose, works on the open design. Off: no AI button, shortcut, menu entry or panel, and nothing is looked for or started.
ui.ai_switch_tip: Change the agent for this conversation
ui.ai_test_acp_tip: Starts the agent briefly and asks it for a session; ends it again
ui.ai_test_anthropic_tip: Sends a short message to the endpoint
ui.ai_test_api_tip: Asks the endpoint for its models
ui.ai_tool_unfold: Click to show what it returned
ui.ai_toolbar_button: Show Assistant button in application bar
ui.ai_toolbar_button_note: The Assistant button in the application bar. Ctrl+Shift+A and the View menu still open the panel.
ui.ai_undo_tip: Undo everything the agent changed for this message, as one step
ui.ambient_occlusion_help: Soft shading where opaque surfaces meet. Requires the GPU viewport.
ui.center_arc_follows_cursor: Center point arc follows the cursor's direction
ui.center_arc_follows_cursor_tip: A center point arc runs clockwise or counter-clockwise the way the cursor goes round its center. Off: always counter-clockwise from the start.
ui.click_then_press_key: Click, then press the new key
ui.colour_vision_deutan_tip: For a weak or missing green sense
ui.colour_vision_note: Changes the colors that carry a meaning: sketch states, axes, bends, analyses and icons. If you use Windows color filters, keep this Off.
ui.colour_vision_protan_tip: For a weak or missing red sense
ui.colour_vision_tritan_tip: For a weak or missing blue sense
ui.command_palette_hint: Type a command, e.g. {example}  — or press S to search
ui.construction.angle_hint: Construction line: click a point, then type an angle or pick a direction
ui.construction.axis_hint: Construction line: click a point, or type its distance from the sketch axis
ui.construction.bisector_hint: Bisector: pick two intersecting straight lines, then the desired solution
ui.construction.common_hint: Common tangent: pick two circles/arcs, then the desired solution
ui.construction.contact_hint: Tangent: pick a circle/arc or open spline/conic, then the contact point (free-form curves: endpoints)
ui.construction.external_hint: Tangent: pick a circle or arc, an external point, then the desired solution
ui.construction.free_hint: Construction line: click two points; right-click to restart
ui.construction.parallel_hint: Construction line: pick a straight line, then click or type the offset; right-click to change the reference
ui.construction.point_hint: Construction line: click the point to pass through
ui.construction.reference_hint: Construction line: pick a straight line, then a point; right-click to change the reference
ui.cosmetic_thread_markings_help: Show schematic markings on threaded cylindrical walls. Changes only the display, never the design or exports.
ui.custom_program_tip: Choose a slicer program to add to the list
ui.delete_select_first: Select what to delete first: features, bodies, components or sketch geometry
ui.design_properties.author: Author
ui.design_properties.exports: STEP, IGES and 3MF exports carry these where the format has a place for them.
ui.design_properties.not_text: Saved as something other than text; typing here replaces it.
ui.design_properties.others_note: Kept in the design as it is and never exported.
ui.details_access_caption: Faces show whether a tool can reach them from the chosen direction.
ui.details_continuity_caption: Edit the selected seam. Other seams keep their own settings.
ui.details_continuity_stale: Earlier geometry: rerun the analysis to edit or frame this seam.
ui.details_curvature_caption: Faces are colored by their local radius of curvature.
ui.details_draft_caption: Faces are colored by their angle to the pull direction.
ui.details_fixture_caption: Component specimen with illustrative values; this is not a model result.
ui.details_zebra_caption: Reflected stripes show how smoothly faces join.
ui.direct_interaction_note: Work on the model directly in the viewport. Press a flat face or a profile and pull: up extrudes, down into a body cuts, and sideways movement sets the step size
ui.easyprint_consent: EasyPrint is Printables' slicer in the browser. To open the model there, SolidCraft uploads it to Printables' servers. The link expires after 30 minutes, and you'll need to be signed in to Printables. Continue?
ui.edit_in_place_after_turn: The edit finishes when the agent's turn ends
ui.edit_in_place_agent_busy: The agent is still working in this design; try again once its turn is done
ui.edit_in_place_already_queued: An edit already waits for the end of the agent's turn
ui.edit_in_place_busy: Finish or cancel what is open first
ui.edit_in_place_none: No linked design is edited in place
ui.edit_in_place_not_saved: The part has changes that are not saved; save it to finish editing
ui.edit_in_place_opens_after_turn: The part opens when the agent's turn ends
ui.edit_in_place_refresh_dropped: The assembly changed while Update Links ran; run it again
ui.edit_in_place_refresh_stopped: Update Links stopped before it was done
ui.edit_in_place_save_first: Save the assembly first: its linked designs are found from its file
ui.edit_in_place_save_waits: Update Links is running in {name}; save it once it is done
ui.edit_in_place_saved_elsewhere: The part was saved to another file; the assembly still links {name}
ui.edit_in_place_wait: Wait until what is running in the design is done
ui.emboss_wrap_note: Orthogonal line profiles tangent to one supported cylinder wrap automatically. Pick a wall to choose a target.
ui.equation_note: The variable is a plain number: sin(t) takes it in radians. A result without a unit is in the design's unit.
ui.equation_note_range: The variable is a length, as its range is: mix it with length parameters, and divide it by a length for sin(). A result without a unit is in the design's unit.
ui.explode_needs_two_components: Exploded View pulls components apart, so the design needs two or more of them (New Component, Insert Design or Create Components from Bodies)
ui.export_keymap_tip: Keys, S box favorites and the toolbar, as a file
ui.extract_design_changed: The design changed while choosing a file. Start Extract to File again.
ui.extract_done: The component is now its own design, linked here.
ui.extrude_auto_to_object_tip: In Extrude, with a profile picked, picking a face, vertex or parallel plane off its plane switches the extent to To Object
ui.gpu_memory_lowered: The graphics card is out of memory: the view is drawn at a lower quality.
ui.graphics_preset_help: Quality: ambient occlusion, Fine display quality and adaptive 2× supersampling. Performance: no ambient occlusion, Normal display quality and supersampling off. Manual changes show Custom. MSAA stays unchanged.
ui.grid_follows_view_hint: Side views show the grid on the upright plane facing them instead of the ground
ui.hide_origin_note: New designs start with the Origin folder hidden. A design keeps its own Origin setting once you show or hide it.
ui.history_marker_tip: History marker: drag to roll the model back; new features go here
ui.history_play_finish_action: Finish the current action before playing History
ui.history_play_roll_back: Move the History marker back before playing
ui.insert_design.saved_file: {name} has unsaved changes, so its saved file was inserted. Save it, then Update Links to bring the changes in.
ui.lasso_select: Lasso (drag a freehand loop: takes what is wholly inside)
ui.line_arc_hint: Tangent arc: click the arc's end. Rest on the last point again for lines; right-click or Esc to finish
ui.link_copies_text: These components build the same bodies as {name}. Make them placements of its link?
ui.look_at_anim_desc: Axis view, Look At, Home and Fit
ui.manipulator_free_alt: Manipulator free drag also on Alt/Option
ui.manipulator_free_alt_tip: On: Alt/Option or Ctrl/Cmd on extrude / gizmo arrows disables value snapping. Off: Ctrl/Cmd only.
ui.material_review.axes: Material-local axes; no body orientation is assigned.
ui.material_review.claims: Sources and licenses are unverified claims. Missing values remain unknown.
ui.material_review.limit: The card exceeds the 256 KiB input limit.
ui.material_review.scope: Candidate only: not assigned or saved. Numerical validation is not engineering certification.
ui.material_review.title: Review Physical Material Data
ui.nav_bridge: Navigate with a device app on this computer
ui.nav_bridge_tip: A 3D input device's own program (for example a homemade 3D mouse's driver) moves the view over a local connection, so the mouse pointer stays yours. SolidCraft connects to it on this port on this computer only.
ui.not_a_program: {path} is not a program that can be started
ui.offer_to_stand_up_y_up_files: Offer to stand up Y-up files
ui.part_size_needs_a_part: Select an inserted standard part (a screw, nut, washer or pin) to change its size. To make a body larger or smaller, use Scale.
ui.part_size_shared: Rebuilds the part, replacing any added features. All occurrences of this component update.
ui.pattern_object_type_tip:
Bodies: solid shapes, picked in the view or the Browser; each is copied whole.
Features: steps of the History, such as an extrude or a hole, picked in the History or on a face they made; the step is repeated.
A sketch is neither: repeat its curves with the sketch's own Pattern or Mirror, or extrude it first.
ui.placement_handles_tip: Handles on the preview of a Rest, Boss or Snap Fit: drag the marker to move it across the model, turn it by its ring
ui.plugins_desktop: Plugins are available in the desktop app.
ui.plugins_note: Each plugin is a folder inside {path} with a plugin.json. SolidCraft reads that file and does not run any code from the folder. Turning a plugin off keeps it installed.
ui.point_cloud_legend_filter: Shown and hidden in the legend above
ui.print_face_body_not_sent: That face's body is not being sent: add it to Bodies first
ui.print_face_pick: Select one flat face of a solid body to make it the print face
ui.print_face_set: {body}: print face set; Send to Slicer lays the body on it
ui.project_face_edges_sketch: Project face edges into new sketches
ui.properties.inertia_note: About the center of mass, in world axes (g·{unit}²)
ui.properties.inertia_unavailable: Not available: a body's mesh does not close.
ui.relink_design_changed: The assembly changed while choosing a source. Start Relink Source again.
ui.relink_not_linked: This component is not linked to a source design.
ui.relink_select_one: Select one linked component or one of its instances first.
ui.repeat_nothing: Nothing to repeat yet: start a tool or dialog first.
ui.replace_with_link_done: The copies are now placements of the linked design.
ui.reset_the_settings_on_this_page: Reset the settings on this page
ui.reverse_horizontal_pan_tip: Horizontal two-finger scrolling and the thumb wheel pan the other way
ui.reverse_trackpad_orbit_tip: Shift with two-finger scrolling orbits the other way
ui.reverse_vertical_pan_tip: Vertical two-finger scrolling pans the other way
ui.ribbon_menus_skip_pinned: Leave pinned commands out of the drop-down menus
ui.ribbon_pin_footer: Pinned commands show on the ribbon. Hover a row to pin or unpin it.
ui.save_mesh_no_slicer_open: No slicer found: choose Custom… and pick your slicer program
ui.sbox_pin: Pin to the top of the S box
ui.select_components_by_face: Select components (a face picks its component)
ui.selection_shift_add_only_tip: On: Shift adds items, Ctrl/Cmd toggles. Off (default): Shift and Ctrl/Cmd both toggle.
ui.send_to_slicer_unavailable: Send to Slicer needs the desktop app: a browser can't start a program
ui.sent_to_slicer_copy: Sent to {slicer} as {file}, because the first file is still open there
ui.shortcut_capture_add_key: Add one ordinary key. Escape cancels.
ui.shortcut_capture_hint: Click a binding, then press modifiers and one key. Add modifiers within one second; release all keys to confirm. Escape cancels.
ui.shortcut_capture_press: Press modifiers and one key. Escape cancels.
ui.shortcut_capture_release: Release all keys to confirm. Escape cancels.
ui.shortcut_cycles_modes: Pressing a tool's shortcut again switches its mode
ui.shortcut_cycles_modes_tip: Before the first point, pressing a sketch tool's shortcut again steps through its creation modes. Off: it starts the tool again.
ui.shortcut_multiple_keys: Use modifiers and only one other key. Click the binding to try again.
ui.sketch_report.title: Sketch Report
ui.slicer_delete_tip:
{program}
Press Delete to remove it from the list
ui.slicer_lost: {slicer} was started but can't be found again to send it the file. The file is saved at {path}: open it from there.
ui.slicer_no_file: {slicer} is ready, but there is no file to send to it.
ui.slicer_no_response: {slicer} didn't respond in time. The file is already saved at {path}: send it again once the slicer has started.
ui.slicer_resend_hint: Sending again replaces the file the slicer has open.
ui.slicer_single_instance: Open files in a slicer that is already running
ui.slicer_single_instance_tip: PrusaSlicer, SuperSlicer and Cura load the file in the window that is open instead of starting another. Other slicers are started as they are. PrusaSlicer 3.0 always does this: its launcher can't take a file any other way.
ui.slicer_still_starting: Still waiting for {slicer} to start. Nothing else was sent.
ui.slicer_stl_fallback: The 3MF could not be written, so this is an STL.
ui.smooth_wheel_zoom_tip: Turn off to apply each wheel event immediately, without a smoothing tail
ui.stand_up_tip: After a STEP or IGES file opens with Z up, offer a quarter turn about X
ui.step_values: Step values with the arrow keys and the wheel
ui.step_values_tip: In a value field you are typing in, Up/Down change a plain number by 1 (Shift: 10, Alt: 0.1), and so does the mouse wheel over the field. Expressions are left as typed.
ui.supersampling_adaptive: Only when the view is still
ui.suppress_auto_snap_note: Default: Ctrl/Cmd or Alt/Option each suppress sketch snapping. Choose a single key to narrow it.
ui.timeline_left_note: The vertical history sits to the left of the browser. Toggle feature names on the strip.
ui.toolbar_tabs_hidden: Every toolbar tab is hidden. Click + or right-click here to show one.
ui.trackpad_pan_tip: Two-finger scroll pans; in Fusion, Shift + two fingers orbits. Off: scroll zooms. Mouse wheel and pinch zoom; thumb wheel pans sideways.
ui.up_axis_note: Which axis points up in the views (axis view, Home, Look At). Designs are unchanged.
ui.view_angles_convention: Degrees about the up axis. Yaw 0° is the Front view, 90° Left, −90° Right, 180° Back; pitch 90° is the Top view; a positive roll turns the model clockwise.
ui.view_angles_help: Shows the view's pitch, yaw and roll in degrees and its projection under the orientation gizmo. Click the readout to type exact angles.
ui.workspace_animation_description: Exploded views, motion studies and storyboards
ui.workspace_design_tabs: Model · Surface · Assemble · Insert · Inspect · Manage · View
ui.workspace_drawing_description: 2D drawings with views, dimensions and title blocks
ui.workspace_footer: Every workspace works on the same design, history and selection; only the ribbon tabs change. The switcher is locked while a sketch or feature is being edited.
ui.workspace_render_description: Product preview, scene settings and rendered images
ui.zoom_to_cursor_tip: The wheel zooms toward the point under the cursor (off: toward the view's center)
